How to read this board

This Top 10 orders the 13 Northeast Indiana FRC teams by official FIRST Indiana district points, as reported by The Blue Alliance: the same order as the standings on the home page. EPA (Expected Points Added) is Statbotics’ estimate of how many points a robot adds to its alliance’s score in an average match, like points per game. It is a model, so it can be off early in a season; it is shown for context and does not set the order.
